evidenceSummary.RENDERED: 85 inspection boards at frame size from the canvas wrapper files: 80 page boards fit their frame exactly; 5 overlay boards (P01, C05, C11, X01, X02) are window-sized frames by design, with the page continuing under the overlay; on all 85: no horizontal overflow, no console error or warning, no failed request. Width sweep: 69 states × 1440/1024/768/375, full page (276 renders), and 5 overlays at 1440 and 375 (10 renders): no horizontal overflow, no console output, no failed request
evidenceSummary.LOGIC TESTED: 11 journeys, 243 scripted steps, 0 failed, and no console error or warning on any page they opened; link crawl 265 clicks from 24 starting states — 208 landed on the declared destination, 5 on the intended page under another ID (Edit catalogue details and Edit delivery link open the correction draft in CM-08; Sign in returns to CM-01), 52 correctly blocked by an open account menu or drawer, 0 failed
evidenceSummary.SOURCE CHECKED: base CSS byte-identical; no href="#"; every button has a handler; no tokens added; sample world identical to version 15 (record by record); cm.css selectors all match markup on a board or, where noted in CHECKS.md, in the live preview only; CM-10 absent; no Release or Hold in product UI; no checkpoint or propagation wording in the shipped files
evidenceSummary.NOT TESTED: the Claude Design host’s Play mode and board chrome; real screen readers; browsers other than Chromium; touch; 200 % zoom and forced colours
